entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, isn't that a [clr 2]terminal[clr 27]?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Can you mess with it and figure out how[n]they're cheating, Oracle?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wellll... this one's on standby.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh, basically I'm gonna have to[n]activate it remotely from a main[n]terminal somewhere else.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So this one is useless unless we can access[n]the main hub.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh well. We should at least commit this[n]place to memory for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm? Look! Isn't this one of the control[n]panels we want!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oooh, it definitely is! I never thought it'd[n]be tucked back here.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 'Kay, just finished disabling it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That means we just need to find the [clr 2]red[clr 27][n]panel now. Let's go!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There we go. This is the other control[n]panel we need.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Gotcha! We'll be done after this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Hold on.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, what now?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oracle, would it be possible to also tamper[n]with the average win percentages for the[n]slot machines?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So you want to take advantage of the system,[n]just like we did for the dice game.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Essentially. My aim here is the giant[n]slot machine.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see. By raising the average win percentage,[n]we'll make it near impossible for us to lose.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You can do that!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You betcha. I can do anything.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Cheating seems somehow wrong though...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The odds are stacked against us in[n]this casino.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We would never win if we stuck[n]to normal methods.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We do not have any time to waste[n]either. It would be best for us[n]to focus on our objective.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You're right. Changing my sister's heart[n]is the ultimate goal here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm glad you agree. In that case, let us target[n]the giant slot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean the one that's 5,000 coins a play!?[n]I don't know if that's really possible...!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oooh, sounds like fun to me.[n]Just gimme a sec.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Job's done! I disabled all the cheating[n]mechanisms in the area.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The giant one's still only on an 8:2 ratio[n]though. There's honestly no guarantee[n]it'll work properly.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Does that mean it will miss two times[n]out of ten? That's somewhat concerning...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It should be fine.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Nothing the Phantom Thieves do can ever[n]be truly considered risk-free, after all.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If we want to succeed, we simply have no[n]other choice but this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That seems like a sound argument to me.[n]Very well, let's leave this to Joker then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh by the way, we already know[n]where we're goin'. You wanna[n]head there now, Joker?
